# Cinematic review fixture

`jacket-preview.png` is an original AI-generated synthetic product photograph created on 2026-10-25 with the built-in image generation tool. It is for isolated browser fixtures and design evidence only. It depicts no verified retailer item, price, inventory, or offer and must never replace merchant product imagery in production catalog data.

No source photograph, logo, brand mark, or image reference was supplied to the generator. The user authorized original synthetic visual fixtures for this design review. The image was inspected: an unbranded black shell jacket, complete sleeves and hem visible, charcoal studio background, no text or watermark. It was copied without image edits or recompression.

`jacket.svg`, `footwear.svg` and `beauty.svg` are original geometric SVG illustrations authored for this review. They provide a lightweight fallback, a wide packshot and a portrait beauty container. They contain no copied reference assets or brand marks and represent no real inventory. Retailer names and sample prices in fixture JSON test attribution and layout only; these assets are never imported into the production catalog.

## Exact generation prompt

```text
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: synthetic product photograph fixture for an offline ecommerce interface design review; not a real product offer.
Primary request: Create one original, unbranded black technical shell jacket, ghost-mannequin studio photography, front three-quarter view.
Scene/backdrop: seamless charcoal graphite studio background, restrained and premium.
Subject: a complete black technical shell jacket with a refined stand collar and clean functional construction, no mannequin visible.
Style/medium: realistic luxury product photography with believable fabric texture and precise edge definition.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 composition, complete garment including sleeves and hem visible with generous margin, jacket centered.
Lighting/mood: softly directional silver highlights, restrained dimensionality, natural shadows and quiet luxury.
Color palette: graphite, charcoal, near-black, muted silver illumination.
Constraints: original design, no logo, no text, no watermark, no branded details; do not copy any reference image or existing garment. No person or extra objects.
```
